column1: # The registered competitor versions on Linux, ONE table (gate-6 review, t3run item 13; PREREG §6(6): Dolt 2.4.1,
# Doltgres 1.4.0, PostgreSQL 18). fetch_dolt.sh, the workflow's PG install and run_system.sh all read it (pins.py)
# and refuse a mismatch. Tarball sha256s are the digests GitHub reports for the release assets
# (`gh release view <tag> -R dolthub/<repo> --json assets`, field digest, read 2026-10-08T20:3xZ). The PG row is the
# PGDG package installed in run 37809124979 (`dpkg-query -W postgresql-18`), PostgreSQL 18.6 like the Mac's
# Homebrew postgresql@18 18.6. The annex's binary table holds the Mac rows; these are its Linux rows.
